short_description: Square D Homeline standard circuit breaker, rated 30 A at 120/240 V AC, with 2-pole plug-in mounting and a 10 kA interrupt rating.
long_description:
Square D HOM230CP is a Homeline standard circuit breaker rated for 30 A and 120/240 V AC. This 2-pole breaker features plug-in mounting, a 10 kA interrupt rating, and a 2-inch width.

Wire capacity is 1 x AWG 14 to AWG 8 aluminum/copper or 2 x AWG 14 to AWG 10 copper. UL Listed and compliant with the EU RoHS Directive; REACh, EU RoHS, and China RoHS declarations are available. Lifetime warranty. Country of origin: Mexico.
